rationale: WWD gapped up ~3.6% on 4.3x relative volume and ran to $350 intraday, but price has since pulled back to $333.71, sitting at only 27% of today's range and below the session VWAP of $337.18 — indicating the early momentum has faded and sellers are in control of the current range. With no clear structural edge in either direction at this mid-range, indeterminate location, skipping preserves capital.
